hypothesis: M194 is the best fixed-objective low-drift actor update from M189, and M195 shows the same actor-update recipe is repeat-stable. A tiny guarded PPO smoke from M194 may test whether PPO can retain the refreshed objective and proof-surface gains without behavior or replay regression.
success_criteria: run only a tiny PPO smoke, not a longer continuation
preserve old M183 M168/M170 replay gates and refreshed M193 M189 replay gate
compare fixed M193 objective against M189 and M194 before accepting any continuation
failure_criteria: chain multiple PPO stages before one smoke passes
drop any M183 or M193 replay row
promote based only on training reward or fixed objective improvement

commands.name: m196_guarded_ppo_smoke
commands.command: Run a tiny guarded PPO smoke from M194 using the existing M185 smoke recipe adapted only by init checkpoint.

commands.name: m196_retention_gates
commands.command: Run fixed objective, replay, behavior, and protected-key gates before admitting any PPO repeat.

decision_rule: Only a tiny PPO smoke that preserves behavior, protected key, old replay, and refreshed replay may admit PPO repeats.
